display_title: Love is a Sport: Our Golden Promise
description:
Judo star Joo-Young and Taekwondo star Do-Yoon have been rivals and best friends since childhood. Now, they stand on the world’s biggest stage at the Olympic Games. After clinching her gold medal, Joo-Young decides it’s time to bury her long-held unrequited love for Do-Yoon once and for all. Using a childhood bet as her excuse, she asks him for a single night together to create one final memory. She expected a polite rejection or a simple favor, but Do-Yoon’s intense reaction suggests he has been waiting for this moment even longer than she has. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note:
\- Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.*
\- includes three extra chapters.
